4476-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4476-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

245-2034-3129.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating four creature tokens due to Primal Vigor.
When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

5478-5531-5694-6991-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5478-5531-5694-6991-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
5478-5531-5694-6991-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Donnie & April and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4613-8036.description:
Activate Christine Chapel by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Christine Chapel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2728-5662-5686-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5662-5686-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5662-5686-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

277-4094-6753-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-4094-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

533-7824-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
533-7824-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Bard.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4682-6441-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-6441-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

648-5757-7824.notablePrerequisites:
Sokrates does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give a creature haste.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
648-5757-7824.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your eck size.
Give the Fractal token haste, if needed.
Activate Sokrates by tapping it, targeting the Fractal token.
Declare the Fractal token as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
When the Fractal token would deal combat damage, instead prevent that damage. The defending player draws cards equal to the Fractal's power, rounded down, while you will draw double that many cards due to Bard.

4360-4644-7791.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Greenweaver Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Greenweaver Druid.
Repeat.

3375-3532-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3375-3532-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

549-3259-5953-7295.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-5953-7295.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-5953-7295.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3490-4742-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4742-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

465-2034-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4636-5159-6291.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter and Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, Mishra's Warform and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger twice each, causing you to get eight {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2173-4050-5220-6937.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kalastria Highborn, adding {B}.
When Kalastria Highborn dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Kalastria Highborn trigger, causing you to pay {B} to have an opponent lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kalastria Highborn from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Kalastria Highborn from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.
2173-4050-5220-6937.notes: If desired, you can sacrifice another Vampire instead of Kalastria Highborn. The Vampire must have a mana value of 2 or less. If it has a mana value of 1 or less, you'll also gain infinite life.

6331-6848-6849.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
6331-6848-6849.description:
Donate control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite to an opponent.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 3.

3705-4050-5997-6747.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1263-2060-3967-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-3967-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1018-1235.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Skullwinder with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Skullwinder token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

4067-4798-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4067-4798-5632.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers. Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
Repeat from step 2.

1029-5028-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Selvala.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5457.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

2292-2425-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2292-2425-6249--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

969-1308-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

38-659-969.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-969.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

220-428-1946-4493.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Nomads en-Kor indestructible.
You have a way to target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
220-428-1946-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ghyrson Starn.
Give Nomads en-Kor indestructible, if needed, and then target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Repeat step 3 until only 1 damage will be dealt to Nomads en-Kor.
Resolve the spell or ability, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and any remaining damage to Brash Taunter.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger for the damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, along with Brash Taunter. Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token also trigger for the damage dealt to Brash Taunter if exactly 1 damage  was dealt to it.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn token triggers, dealing 2 damage to Nomads en-Kor, and 2 damage to Brash Taunter, if applicable.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, if applicable, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and 1 damage to Brash Taunter.
The Ghyrson Starn token triggers twice, and Brash Taunter triggers once.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn token trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger from step 14, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn token trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor in step 14, dealing 1 damage to Brash Taunter and 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor.
Repeat from step 14 one additional time, with the nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggering instead of the token Ghyrson Starn.
Repeat from step 14.

471-1189-3260.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Pestilence Demon lifelink.
Your life total is at least 3.
471-1189-3260.description:
Give Pestilence Demon lifelink by any method.
Activate Pestilence Demon by paying 2 life, dealing 1 damage to each creature and player and gaining life equal to the damage dealt this way.
Repeat.

1109-1123-1636-2438.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Flayer of the Hatebound does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1109-1123-1636-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound.
Flayer of the Hatebound dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Flayer of the Hatebound enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Flayer of the Hatebound trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Flayer of the Hatebound.
Repeat.

197-2177-3096-4677.description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, searching your library for all nonlands card and exiling them, then shuffle.
Cast Risen Reef by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Risen Reef enters the battlefield, revealing cards from the top of your library and putting a land card onto the battlefield.
Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 Elemental token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you put all lands from your library onto the battlefield.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two and drawing you a card.
Jace triggers, winning you the game.

4131-4241-4893.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
4131-4241-4893.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
 Repeat from step 3.
